panel_alignment.panel_label_anchor_check: not_requested because panel identifiers and dataset labels are combined in one in-axes tag

panels.interpretation_caveat: Relative errors are highly sensitive to near-zero Monte Carlo reference attributions; use RMSE as the primary metric.

ofa_iid_linear.reason: OFA linear is omitted from the four-panel presentation at the user's request; its completed measurements remain unchanged in the source reports.

s_diff.reason: S-Diff is omitted from the Cancer panel because its O(n^2) pairwise state has poor memory scalability at larger n. The source report retains the completed Cancer measurements.

shapdoe_coa.reason: ShapDoE-COA is omitted at the user's request; source measurements are retained.

tmc_clipping: Keep all observed points and clip the drawn line at the target-budget viewport; do not reposition or delete TMC-Shapley.

uncertainty_display.unit: estimator seed, fixed data split and reference
uncertainty_display.log_axis_policy: nonpositive lower bounds clipped to the y viewport for display only
